headline: Carney 🍁👨‍💼 SLAMS Trump 🍊👑 Tariffs as 'MISFIRE' 💥 after TRADE WAR 💣💥 ERUPTS!
text: Canada's PM Mark Carney 🍁👨‍💼 reluctantly 💔 dropped the TARIFF BOMB 💣 after Trump 🍊👑's 'MIS-CALCULATION' 😵‍💫 went BRRRRR 💸💥! 'They ASKED TOO MUCH 🍔 and OFFERED TOO LITTLE 🍟' he said, turning a TRADE DEAL 🤝 into a full-blown TRADE WAR ⚔️💸! New 50% US tariffs hit $20BN worth of Canadian imports 📦🤑, slapping steel 🏗️, dairy 🥛, appliances 📺, electronics 📱, wine 🍷, cement 🧱, clothing 👕 and HOCKEY STICKS 🏒 with the BIG LEAGUE HURT! Carney's ready to MATCH 'EM DOLLAR-FOR-DOLLAR 💵💵, launching retaliatory tariffs from September 8th 🗓️🔥! Ontario's Doug Ford 🏈👨‍💼 says Trump 'CAN'T BE TRUSTED' 🤡, while BC's David Eby 🌲👨‍💼 warns it turns Canada into the 'ECONOMIC 51ST STATE' 🗺️😩! Quebec's Christine Fréchette 🏒👩‍💼 fears JOBS GONE 🏭💨 and Alberta's Danielle Smith 🛢️👩‍💼 wants both sides back at the TABLE 🍽️! Pierre Poilievre 🗳️👨‍💼 called the levies 'UNJUSTIFIED' 😤 while Jamieson Greer 📺👨‍💼 says talks are DEAD 💀, no resumption plans 📵! Even the USMCA review 🔄📜 got SHAKEN 🥤, not stirred 🍸! Canadians are BOYCOTTING US 🇺🇸🛍️ and Carney says it's 'CERTAINLY NOT GOOD NEWS' 📉📰! Trump 🍊👑 still SILENT 🤐 while critics say his tariffs raise prices 💸📈 and tank the GLOBAL ECONOMY 🌍😭! Carney faces the ULTIMATE TEST 🧪 after walking away from Trump's 'UNACCEPTABLE' TERMS 🚫, proving Canada won't be BULLIED 🐂💥 or turned into anyone's 51ST STATE 🗺️💔!
